title: Decompose prefill/decode pipeline to enable chunked & speculative prefill with stage overlap
author: Lina Park
release_notes: Improves end-to-end latency for long-context prefill workloads by enabling chunked prefill, speculative decoding to overlap compute, and scheduler adjustments to maximize GPU utilization. No API changes.
description: Motivation: Prefill (context encoding) and decode have traditionally been serialized at the pipeline level which leaves GPUs underutilized for long-context prompts or when using KV cache. This PR decomposes the pipeline into explicit stages so we can: 1) split prefill into fixed-size chunks (chunked prefill) to produce KV segments early, 2) speculatively start decode on available tokens while later prefill chunks are computed, and 3) overlap prefill and decode stages via an explicit stage scheduler. Design summary: implement a PrefillChunker that emits KV checkpoints, add a SpeculativeDecode orchestrator that monitors token-level readiness, and replace monolithic PipelineRunner with a StagedPipeline that can run prefill/decode tasks on different streams. Changes include lightweight kernel hooks to accept partial KV inputs, scheduler heuristics to prefer low-latency decoding on tail tokens, and KV cache eviction guards to avoid double-use races. Results: see perf_results_summary. Checklist: [x] design doc link: https://redwood.internal/docs/prefill-decode-stage-design [x] unit tests added for chunker and stage transitions [x] integration test for KV consistency [x] perf harness runs included [ ] finalize docs. Related: ENG-4021, ENG-4130. Merge notes: squash-merged after perf run confirmed 12-28% P50 improvements on long-context generative workloads, and no regression on short-context fast-paths.

refactor: remove monolithic PipelineRunner and wire StagedPipeline (lina/refactor)

review_comments: Marco Ruiz: The new kernel hook looks good but we need to ensure memory alignment for partial KV writes; please add assertions and a fallback path.
Lina Park: Added alignment checks and a fallback memcpy path to the kernel; updated unit tests to cover misaligned edge cases.
Asha Patel: Scheduler heuristics look promising. How do we prevent speculative decode from consuming tokens that later get invalidated due to out-of-order prefill?
Lina Park: We add a lightweight token versioning stamp and validation before decode commits to output; described in comments and tested in integration test.
Devon Li: CI perf job flagged a small regression on 8k sequence when chunk_size was 64; recommend exposing chunk_size and auto-tuning heuristic.
Lina Park: Exposed chunk_size to config and added an auto-tuner which samples 3 sizes at startup. Added notes to release notes.
perf_results_summary: Long-context (16k tokens) generation P50 latency: baseline 1420ms -> 1248ms (12% improvement)
Tail-latency (first decode token readiness): baseline 84ms -> 62ms (26% improvement)
Throughput (batched continuous) on 4xA100: +18% tokens/sec for mixed short/long workload
Memory: peak GPU memory up by 3% due to chunk buffers; KV consistency tests show no extra leaks
kernel_changes: Add partial-KV consumer API to attention kernel (accepts KV segment offsets)
Add fast path for single-chunk prefill to reuse existing fused kernels
Backwards-compatible fallback path that reconstructs full KV for older runtimes
scheduler_changes: Introduce StagedScheduler that tracks readiness per-token and per-chunk
SpeculativeDecode policy: start decode when head chunk + n speculative tokens ready (n configurable)
Auto-tuner selects chunk_size and speculative_depth based on sampling during warm-up
kv_cache_changes: PrefillChunker emits KV checkpoints to KVCache as segmented entries
KVCache adds segment-level version stamps to prevent decode races
Eviction guards prevent overwriting segments that are being read by speculative decode
notes: This PR touches both runtime and kernel layers; coordinate with release engineering for backported patches to release/1.8 if needed.
Follow-up work: tighter kernel fusion for multi-chunk decode path and better memory reclamation for ephemeral chunk buffers.
